title: Bulungan language
extract: The Bulungan language, also known as Bolongan and Bulongan, is an Austronesian language spoken in Bulungan Regency, North Kalimantan. The language was the court language of the Bulungan Sultanate. The classification of this language is not clear. Glottolog places it in the Sabahan group.
